title: Paystride Payroll Card Program Agreement — Launch, Suspension, Termination and Package Changes
content:
## Clauses

**L1 Launch.** The program launches when its first payroll batch posts, which Paystride commits to make possible within the package's launch target of business days of signing.

**L2 Suspension.** The desk suspends only a program whose status is live. The desk suspends a live program when the funding returns booked in the 90 calendar days ending today reach the package's suspension count or the funding balance stays negative longer than the package's negative-balance period in business days; while suspended only batches funded by wire or already-cleared funds post.

**L3 Reinstatement.** A suspended program is reinstated once the balance is restored and the reinstatement fee is debited.

**L4 Requesters.** *No longer in force:* "A package change or termination notice is accepted only from a requester whose role is listed in the package's authorized requester roles." This clause is no longer in force as written; it is superseded by the current basis for termination notices and package changes.

**L5 Termination.** Termination is the employer's own decision. A termination takes effect no earlier than the package's notice period in calendar days after the termination notice date. Calendar days are counted from the day after the termination notice date, so the earliest termination date is that date plus the notice days. Workers keep their card accounts after termination; only employer loads stop.

**L6 Package change.** A package change takes effect on the first day of the next calendar month, at most the package's allowance of package changes in any 365 days — counting the package change requests that are scheduled or effective in the 365 calendar days ending on the submission date — only into a package whose entry threshold the program meets, and moves every worker's card to that package's worker card plan on the same day.

**L7 Funding method.** A funding method change is limited to the package's accepted funding methods.

## Program states of a Paystride Payroll Card Program

| From | To | By | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| contracted | live | system | the first payroll batch posts to cards |
| live | suspended | the desk | returned funding or a balance left negative, under L2 |
| suspended | live | the desk | funding is cured, under L3 |
| live | terminated | the employer | the termination takes effect at the end of its notice period |

## Notice period cases (hypothetical, a 30-day notice period)

| Termination notice date | Earliest termination date | Termination on that date | Termination the day before |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 June | 5 July | may take effect | too early |
| 20 January | 19 February | may take effect | too early |

The notice date is the termination notice date on the program record, not a date the caller recalls.

superseded_clauses: A package change or termination notice is accepted only from a requester whose role is listed in authorized_requester_roles.
